title: Diary configuration
description: The three configuration keys of the system (specs/02-specification/technical-spec.md, section Configuration). A document of this form is the logical configuration. An implementation reads each key from a command-line option or an environment variable and chooses the names.

database_location.description: Path of the entry store file (REQ-NFR-004).

display_zone.description: Name of the display zone, from the IANA time zone database (REQ-NFR-002). The system stops at start if the name is unknown. A schema cannot check the name against the database.

listen_address.description: Host and port where the system accepts requests. The default is a local address because the system has no sign-in (risk R-5).
